original: WPRPLACE is an island in Vestfjorden, just north of Bodø in Nordland county, Norway. The island belongs to Bodø Municipality and has an area of 30.75-square-kilometre . The highest point on the mountainous island is the 802-metre tall Rypdalstinden.
